preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 300,000.
The number of edges m must be at least n-1 and at most the minimum of 300,000 or the maximum possible edges in a graph.
The number of special vertices k must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n for v_i in special_vertices)
preconditions.description: All special vertex indices must be valid and within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c_i <= 10**9 for c_i in costs)
preconditions.description: All costs c_i for vertices must be non-negative and not exceed 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= w_i <= 10**9 for w_i in edge_weights)
preconditions.description: All edge weights w_i must be non-negative and not exceed 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints must be valid vertex indices and distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers representing the maximum profit for each vertex.

postconditions.expression: all(profits[i] == max_profit(i) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each profit value must correspond to the maximum profit achievable for the respective vertex being saturated.
